role: Root export barrel for Co-Being shared foundational types across all system layers.
detail: Barrel module exporting leaf-level types used throughout Co-Being system: identifiers (NodeId, EdgeId, CorrelationId), provenance tracking (Provenance, ProvenanceSource), observation contract types (Observation, BoundingBox), exceptions (CoBeingError, GraphUnavailableError), circuit breaker pattern (CircuitBreaker, CircuitBreakerOpenError, CircuitBreakerState), and event bus infrastructure (Event, EventBus, EventPriority). No layer-specific dependencies; serves as the dependency tree leaf for all consumers. Designed as the Layer 2/Layer 3 contract boundary for observations.
